summary: Iteration 7 (PDF Preview modal for BOTH list and quote + full-catalog export ignoring filters + premium white/red PDF redesign) fully verified. Backend regression: 64/65 pytest pass (1 flaky test `test_bf_goodrich_present_for_every_role` failed once due to a live Zoho re-sync race — passes cleanly when rerun in isolation and is guarded elsewhere by `if r.status_code != 200: continue`; NOT a regression of the current iteration and the export endpoint suite (15/15) is 100% green). GET /api/products/export still requires bearer (401 without), returns {products,count} with count=418, prices arrays NEVER contain any cost keys (COSTO/COSTO_BS/COSTO_DOLAR/COSTO_ZELLE) for ANY role including master; non-master roles only see their authorized selling columns + BF_GOODRICH. Frontend E2E on 390x844 mobile viewport verified: (1) Roilan Narváez / ventasccs202601 login → Caracas chip active → tapping `download-list` opens `pdf-preview-modal` with the redesigned WHITE background PDF (red C0392B accents, VENEGE color logo in header, kicker 'LISTA DE PRECIOS', title 'Catálogo autorizado', chip 'Caracas', date+time+'418 productos' meta line) rendering the FULL catalog (418 tbody rows) — pdf-preview-share ('Descargar / Abrir PDF' on web) and pdf-preview-close both visible; closing dismisses the modal. (2) With search-input filled ('michelin') the export STILL produces 418 rows (search/filters ignored by 'Descargar lista' as required). (3) Home 'Cotizar' (home-cotizar) opens QuoteModal → quote-add-search 'michelin' → suggestions surface as `quote-sugg-<sku>` → tapping adds a quote-item-<sku> → 'Generar cotización PDF' (quote-generate) opens pdf-preview-modal with the redesigned quote PDF (kicker 'Cotización', htitle 'Cotización de productos', red header bar, logo, itemized table with totals in $) and both share/close visible. (4) Gerencia venege / Master2026gerencia with 'Todos' active → tapping 'Descargar lista' shows testID `export-msg` exactly 'Selecciona un canal para descargar la lista.' and does NOT open the preview; after tapping channel-caracas the preview opens with 418 rows. All required testIDs are present (pdf-preview-modal, pdf-preview-share, pdf-preview-close, download-list, home-cotizar, quote-modal, quote-add-search, quote-sugg-<sku>, quote-item-<sku>, quote-generate, export-msg, channel-all, channel-caracas). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch); expo-print + expo-sharing used correctly with WebView (native) / iframe srcDoc (web) preview per Platform.OS. All UI copy is in Spanish. Costs remain hidden everywhere.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Harden test_bf_goodrich_present_for_every_role with the same 'skip if 404 during live re-sync' guard used by test_master_never_sees_costs to eliminate the pre-existing flake.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx `downloadList()` correctly calls `api.exportList({})` with NO filter args, guaranteeing the FULL authorized catalog is exported regardless of any active search query, RIN or MARCA filters — matches the Phase-1 requirement.

home.tsx Gerencia gating: when `isAll` (Todos) is active, downloadList short-circuits with `setExportMsg('Selecciona un canal para descargar la lista.')` and does NOT call the export API — verified by E2E.

PdfPreviewModal.tsx uses `react-native-webview` on native and a web-only `<iframe srcDoc={html}>` on web (Platform.OS branch) — the correct pattern; testIDs pdf-preview-modal / pdf-preview-share / pdf-preview-close all wired. `share()` uses expo-print printToFileAsync + expo-sharing (native) or window.open (web) — no PDF bytes leaked.

listpdf.ts / quote.ts produce the premium white/red PDF exactly as specified: 2.5px #C0392B header rule, white background, VENEGE logo via data URI, upper-case kicker + red chip on the list, itemized table with per-currency totals in $ on the quote. All strings are HTML-escaped via `esc()`.

Backend `/api/products/export` intentionally still accepts optional rin/marca query params — per the agent-to-agent note, the full-catalog behavior is achieved by the FRONTEND not sending them; NOT flagged as a bug.

quote.ts line 37: minor cosmetic — the SKU/RIN meta line renders as `SKU 003718 · RIN R15"` (extra closing quote after the escaped RIN value). Not blocking; consider dropping the trailing `"` since it is already inside a labeled span.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iteration-7 flows: list preview + full catalog + filter-ignore + quote preview + Gerencia Todos gating)
